review: The Index Proxy - Effloresced E.G.O::Procuration Don Quixote is a strong generalist Poise-Sinking Identity who has two skillsets, the first being the normal one and the second will be called “Enhanced” state. While usually reviews go over both skillsets, in the case of Index Don, this review will forgo the normal skillset due to the uptime and accessibility of the “Enhanced” state. The Sinking application in her kit is merely a bonus, as it does not matter at all for her kit and for Sinking teams.
